spec_source: internal-yaml: authored from Zotero Web API v3 official documentation (api.zotero.org, API version 3) and pyzotero wire behavior; endpoints verified against live library userID 13524464
description: Your entire Zotero research library, searchable offline — version-based incremental sync into SQLite with full-text search no other Zotero tool has.

novel_features.name: Offline research-grounding search
novel_features.description: Ranked full-text search over your synced library — title, abstract, creators, tags, and attachment full text — answered offline in under a second, with snippets and citation-ready metadata.

novel_features.name: Recently-added triage
novel_features.description: What landed in the library recently, sorted by dateAdded from the local cache, with a --days cutoff and pipeable keys.

novel_features.name: Citekey bridge
novel_features.description: Resolves a Better BibTeX citekey to its item from the local cache and exports citekey-faithful BibTeX; sync backfills citekeys via the desktop's local JSON-RPC when available.

novel_features.name: Cached collection tree
novel_features.description: Renders the full collection hierarchy with per-node item counts in one command — a shape the flat API cannot return in one call.

novel_features.name: Cache health and offline reindex
novel_features.description: Sync cursors, row and FTS counts, and last-sync age from the local cache; 'cache reindex' rebuilds the FTS index from base tables with zero network.
